links.outcome: AUC on U.S. external data versus prespecified non-inferiority benchmarks across ten conditions
links.effect: AUCs ranged from 0.883 to 0.949 across ten target conditions; all met non-inferiority criteria relative to prespecified benchmarks.
links.quote: Across ten target conditions, AUCs ranged from 0.883 to 0.949; all met non-inferiority criteria.

links.outcome: ECG-AI AUC versus initial troponin T for AMI and STEMI equivalents in paired subset
links.effect: In paired subset (N = 1368), ECG-AI AUC 0.920 vs 0.878 for AMI and 0.932 vs 0.736 for STEMI equivalents (all P < 0.001).
links.quote: In a paired subset (N = 1368), ECG-AI outperformed initial troponin T for AMI (AUC 0.920 vs. 0.878) and STEMI equivalents (AUC 0.932 vs. 0.736; all P < 0.001).

links.outcome: Model performance consistency across sex and age subgroups
links.effect: Performance was consistent across sex and age strata.
links.quote: Performance was consistent across sex and age strata.

screen.reason: This is an external validation of an existing, deployed ECG AI model (ECG Buddy) on a large multi-center US dataset. It evaluates the retrospective diagnostic performance across multiple conditions but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
